data.reasoning: The package is a standard AUR binary package (-bin) that downloads a pre-built release from the official GitHub repository (github.com/omnidotdev/run-cli) with pinned SHA-256 checksums. Both the PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO contain only standard packaging metadata and installation commands with no executable code in global scope, no network exfiltration, and no supply chain risks. data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by a tool error in Report 1 (qwen3-235b-a22b-2507), which encountered an HTTP 404 NotFoundError when attempting the full PKGBUILD review. This is a coverage issue, not a security disagreement. Report 1's initial PKGBUILD audit succeeded and found it safe, and Report 2 (deepseek-v4-flash) successfully completed the full review of both files and found them safe. There is no actual security disagreement between the models.
coverage_issues: Report 1 (qwen3-235b-a22b-2507) failed to complete PKGBUILD review due to HTTP 404 API error, resulting in inconclusive verdict
learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should be distinguished from security findings - an inconclusive result due to infrastructure failure should not block a safe verdict when other evidence is available
When a full file review fails but an initial audit succeeds, the initial audit results should be weighted in the final verdict
Binary packages (-bin) with pinned checksums from official upstream sources are low-risk and should be fast-tracked when checksums are present and sources are from expected domains
